designer_intent.goal: Create a dark, sparse trip hop arrangement emphasizing strong hooks and experimental sample-based textures.

presetor_intent.goal: Preserve the experimental dark mood with emphasis on sample slicing techniques and texture beds.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate sliced drum samples with sparse patterns that emphasize hooks with strong hits in hook sections.

harmony_generator.brief: Create atmospheric chord samples using looping and slicing techniques to provide texture beds.

melody_generator.brief: Compose lead melodies using one-shot sampled hits focusing on variation and hook prominence.

ai_designer.brief: Arrange the sections to balance sparse verses and energetic hooks with experimental texture layering.

presetor.brief: Apply effects and presets that enhance a dark, experimental trip hop sound focusing on clarity in hooks.

songgps.brief: Coordinate and optimize section transitions and energy curves to maintain listener engagement.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Mix with emphasis on clarity for hooks while maintaining atmosphere and texture in sparse sections.
